caption: The drawing depicts four distinct ornamental objects, all rendered primarily in shades of gold and olive green, with detailed black linework accentuating the forms and textures. At the top center, there is a long decorative piece composed of symmetrical leafy branches extending outward from a central swirl, with small circular elements interspersed along the leaves, all shaded to suggest a metallic surface. Below this, three separate objects are arranged horizontally: on the left, a pointed finial or end cap with leaf motifs and parallel bands; in the center, a three-dimensional cylindrical object ending in a square face, which features a floral design with petals radiating from a central sphere and a scroll-like wheel below; on the right, a square plaque or tile, also decorated with a central floral motif similar to the one seen in the center object. The background is an off-white or parchment-like color. A thin rectangular border surrounds the composition, with a scale in the lower left corner and the name “P. Johnson” in the lower right.
title: Mount and Cup Caster
